english.meaning: to sum up; to put it briefly
english.note: The fuller form 總而言之 is more common. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: In short, he said it’s stretched. So it’s best not to do strenuous exercise from now on.
exampleSentences.traditional: 喀，總言之係，誒，佢話拉長咗。噉呢最好以後就唔好做劇烈運動噉樣講囖。
